synopsis: Simscape is listed as a vehicle and machine dynamics offering and as an implementation option for lumped brake hydraulics coupled to a point-mass model, predicting latency, pressure build-up and its spread [f8357, f6393, f6437]. The glossary describes Vehicle Dynamics Blockset and Simscape as road-heritage tools with articulated steering since R2025a; Chapter 11 identifies articulated-steering dynamics and controller models operating closed-loop in Simulink R2026b [f15975, f8599]. R2026b is the second 2026 release of the twice-yearly MATLAB and Simulink family [f16239]. An undated MathWorks user story reports Volvo Construction Equipment's real-time human-in-the-loop excavator simulator built using Simulink and Simscape, providing an application example but no dated milestone [f8391, f16050]. Despite their inclusion in the dynamics, terrain and soil category, high-detail soil deformation is explicitly not a primary strength of these MathWorks tools [f8357, f8600].

relations.note: Both describe Volvo's real-time human-in-the-loop excavator simulator using Simulink and Simscape.
Specifies coupling, predicted brake responses and additional implementation options for lumped hydraulics.
Adds road heritage and articulated-steering availability since R2025a to the tool classification.
Adds off-road kinematics, controller models and closed-loop operation in R2026b.
Identifies R2026b as the second 2026 release within the twice-yearly software family.
Qualifies the terrain and soil category: high-detail soil deformation is not a primary strength.
An excavator simulator provides a concrete application of Simscape in machine dynamics.
